content.what_it_is: MATLAB animation script for the FUNWAVE-TVD tide_abs_2bc_data simple case. It loads eta_00001 to size the grid [n,m] (L4, L6), builds x and y with dx=dy=2.0 (L7-L10), and selects frames nfile=1..99 (L12). It opens an MPEG-4 VideoWriter videoOut.mp4 at 10 fps, quality 100, with target frame size vidHeight=576 x vidWidth=1024 (L14-L19), sets jet colormap and an 8x5-inch figure (L21-L24). Per frame (L28-L67): loads eta_<fnum> and mask_<fnum> (L30-L32), sets masked-dry cells to NaN via eta(mask==0)=NaN (L34), draws a 3D mesh of eta with fixed axis [0 x(end) 0 y(end) -2 4] and view(17,16) in subplot 1 (L38-L42), plots the mid-row transect eta(floor(n/2),:) in subplot 2 (L44-L47), labels axes (ylabel only on the first frame, L49-L53), forces zbuffer renderer (L57), pauses (L59), rasterizes the figure at 300 dpi via print('-RGBImage'), resizes to 576x1024, stores it in mov(num).cdata, and writes it to the video (L61-L65). Closes the video at L68. A commented jpeg export referencing eta_inlet_shoal_irr.jpg remains at L72.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
eta — surface elevation array, reloaded per frame (L4, L31)
n, m — grid dimensions from size(eta) (L6)
vidHeight — output video height in pixels (L17)
vidWidth — output video width in pixels (L18)
mask — wet/dry mask loaded per frame (L32)
F — RGB image rasterized from the figure (L61)
mov — struct array holding frame cdata (L63)

io.name: two-panel figure: 3D mesh of eta and mid-row transect

unresolved: The ylabel ' y (m) ' is set only when num==1 (L49-L51) but clf (L37) wipes it on every subsequent frame, so frames 2..99 have no ylabel; also it is applied to the transect subplot (1,2,2), the active axes at that point, though 'y (m)' semantically fits the mesh panel.
mov(num).cdata accumulates all 99 resized frames in memory (L63) although each frame is written immediately (L65); the array is never used afterwards.
Frame list starts at 1 (L12) while the sizing load uses eta_00001 (L4) — eta_00000 is skipped; whether that is intentional is not stated.
The commented export name eta_inlet_shoal_irr.jpg (L72) refers to an inlet_shoal case, suggesting this script was copied from another case's postprocessing.
dx=dy=2.0 (L7-L8) are asserted; agreement with the case grid spacing in input.txt is not verifiable from this script.
